Map `ContractViolation` and `ValueError` deterministically to HTTP `400` JSON with `vital_max_hp: 6` and `delta_s: 0` — never leak raw stack traces or silently coerce invalid inputs.
Keep internal module/hypervisor rings strictly binary (`64B WNTC`, `128B KPKT`, `32B .kopt`) and project to UTF-8 JSON/SVG only at the outer HTTP/UI view edge.
Tag every backend field with `LOCAL_MEASURED`, `VERIFIED_WITH_SCOPE`, `DERIVED`, or `UNKNOWN` so neither UI nor downstream prompts over-claim.
